== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Considered the best {{ci|Kindred}} player in Korean server.
* His ID '''Pyosik''' (표식) means "mark" in Korean. The name is a reference to the marks that {{ci|Kindred}} collects.
* First Jungler in LCS to achieve a pentakill.
* Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on April 20, 2025.
** The 32nd player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK.

=== Individual Awards ===
* Player of the Split x1 (2021 Spring) 
* LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x1 (2021 Spring) 
* LCS 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (2023 Summer)
